checks.name: touched_production_test_line_audit
checks.command: { git diff --name-only; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | awk '$0 ~ /^(src|tests)\// {print}' | xargs -r wc -l
checks.scope_note: Counts all current changed and untracked src/ and tests/ paths; unrelated dirty paths remain unattributed and untouched.

asserts: Hall reads and writes use the control-root registry
registered bead root is passed to host-validation evidence verification
bead repository root is joined through hall_repositories
Forge source and intent paths do not fall back to the control root
legacy request remains one request across authorize, execute, and replay
execution is one-shot and replay does not invoke the adapter
independent validator ticket is issued for the delivered receipt
ticket is consumed and validation finalizes as recorded_verified
existing semantic-widening and runtime-drift guards remain present

source_contract_review.result_handler: resolves the registered bead repository root for evidence and uses the control root for Hall persistence
source_contract_review.ticket_controller: derives the host-v3 independent validator principal from the evidence manifest and atomically rejects replay or binding drift
source_contract_review.forge_validation_controller: requires authority-matching verified evidence and preserves v2/v3 subject and finalization distinctions
